com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: Running installations are published to the launcher before tunnel preparation and endpoint checks. Pending entries are delivered as snapshots on the main queue. Failed or cancelled preparation clears the tile. Shared-grid rendering and transition to an installed entry were verified in the simulator.
